visualCharacteristics.variantDescriptor: Photo with a white title card overlapping its bottom edge (title + subtitle in the card), not text over the image.
visualCharacteristics.sectionStylingNotes: Full-width photo (rounded top corners) with a white content card overlapping its lower edge; large dark-navy H1 and subtitle inside the card.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Page-top hero: photo with an overlapping white card holding the H1 and subtitle

contentPattern.structure: row 1: image (with alt); row 2: rich text (H1 heading + subtitle paragraph)
contentPattern.description: Hero photo (man holding children's hands on beach) with H1 "Welcome to our Privacy Center" and subtitle "We are committed to the ethical use of personal data."

usage: Use at the top of a landing page when the title should sit in a card overlapping the bottom of the hero photo rather than over the image.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any hero with a photo and a separate title card. Use the plain hero block when text sits directly over the image.
